entry.direction: Rebuild the dressing-room composition from Reference 1 with physically coherent perspective. Adult Evelynn from Reference 2 wears a fully opaque ivory cotton robe, long sleeves, wrapped closed and tied at waist, hem below knees, simple slippers. Full figure including BOTH FEET and clear floor contact shadows visible, head occupying only the middle upper part of frame; her height is about 70 percent of frame and about three quarters of the wardrobe height. Eye-level 50mm perspective, no wide-angle foreground enlargement. She stands directly beside the open wardrobe within 30cm of the rail, her feet on the same floor depth as the wardrobe threshold. Her right elbow is naturally bent; right fingers curl clearly around the neck of ONE wooden hanger just lifted off the rail. On that hanger she holds a long black elegant evening gown. The selected garment hangs vertically in front of the wardrobe, at natural adult clothing scale. Her left hand gently supports its fabric. She looks at the selected garment rather than the viewer. Replace the tactical outfit on the rail with an ordinary understated cocktail dress. The only choices in this room are a business suit, evening gown and understated cocktail outfit. No tactical suits or gear. Keep the warm vanity lighting, clean illustrated linework, semi-cel shadows, brunette updo, and Evelynn facial identity. Show a believable short reach, normal-length arms, enough space above her head and below her feet. No floating hands or touching a distant jacket.
